# WorkoutX response headers — captured 2026-08-04
#
# Source: GET https://api.workoutxapp.com/v1/exercises?limit=2
#   (a) with no credentials            -> 401, body: error_unauthenticated_401.json
#   (b) with X-WorkoutX-Key: wx_invalid_probe_key -> 401, body: error_invalid_key_401.json
#
# Both responses carried an identical header set. Volatile headers
# (date, etag, content-length, x-railway-request-id, x-hikari-trace,
# x-railway-edge) are stripped.
#
# The access-control-expose-headers value below is the most important artifact
# in this fixture: it enumerates the metering headers WorkoutX exposes, and it
# is returned even on an unauthenticated 401. It is the evidence that a
# unique-GIF quota dimension exists separately from the request quota.

HTTP/2 401
access-control-expose-headers: X-WorkoutX-Plan,X-RateLimit-Limit,X-RateLimit-Remaining,X-Quota-Limit,X-Quota-Remaining,X-Quota-Reset,X-Unique-GIF-Limit,X-Unique-GIF-Used,X-Unique-GIF-Remaining
content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8
cross-origin-opener-policy: same-origin
cross-origin-resource-policy: cross-origin
origin-agent-cluster: ?1
referrer-policy: no-referrer
server: railway-hikari
strict-transport-security: max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains
vary: Origin, Accept-Encoding
x-content-type-options: nosniff
x-dns-prefetch-control: off
x-download-options: noopen
x-frame-options: SAMEORIGIN
x-permitted-cross-domain-policies: none
x-xss-protection: 0

# Metering headers, grouped:
#
#   Plan identity      X-WorkoutX-Plan
#   Per-minute rate    X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining
#   Monthly quota      X-Quota-Limit, X-Quota-Remaining, X-Quota-Reset
#   Unique-GIF quota   X-Unique-GIF-Limit, X-Unique-GIF-Used, X-Unique-GIF-Remaining
#
# NOTE: only the header NAMES are proven. No live values were observed, because
# observing them requires an authenticated request. Per-plan limits, reset
# cadence, and whether re-fetching an already-seen GIF re-counts against
# X-Unique-GIF-Used are all UNKNOWN and are open vendor questions.
